entries.title: Hosts' names spelt right
entries.description: Subtitles and the tap-a-word glossary now spell the show's title, hosts and recurring names correctly on newly prepared episodes.
entries.tryIt: Prepare a new episode and look for the hosts' names in the subtitles

entries.title: Hear Mia before you sign in
entries.description: After picking a language, Mia says hello, explains what Polycast does and teaches a first word in your language.
entries.tryIt: Sign out, then go through the welcome screens

entries.title: Real host, real show
entries.description: The welcome screen says plainly that the host is real and Mia and Leo only step in when the host pauses.
entries.tryIt: Look at the welcome screen

entries.title: A gentle Plus card after the free episode
entries.description: At the end of your free episode the wrap-up shows minutes listened and words kept, then a calm card about Plus.
entries.tryIt: Finish your free episode

entries.title: Downloads stop piling up
entries.description: Downloaded episodes stay out of iCloud backup, are tidied after 30 days unless a saved word needs them, and You shows the space used with a Clear downloads button.
entries.tryIt: Open You and find Downloads

entries.title: Adverts on the scrubber
entries.description: Advert breaks show as a soft band on the scrubber, and Mia waits them out.
entries.tryIt: Play an episode with adverts and look at the scrubber

entries.title: Chart places on top shows
entries.description: Top-chart shows carried their place in the country's chart (since replaced by plain numbers).

entries.title: A nudge when your show has a new episode
entries.description: Finish a show's episode and you'll get at most one nudge a week when it has a new one; tapping a notification opens that episode.
entries.tryIt: Tap any Polycast notification

entries.title: Share a line you caught
entries.description: The wrap-up offers to share a line you caught, with its meaning and the show's credit.
entries.tryIt: Finish an episode and tap Share a line

entries.title: Good first listen
entries.description: A show's page tags one recent, easier episode as a good first listen.
entries.tryIt: Open any show page

entries.title: The logo comes together
entries.description: On the welcome screen the coloured stems slide out from behind the orange pole into the logo.
entries.tryIt: Sign out and watch the welcome screen

entries.title: Mia signs off in your language
entries.description: After the wrap-up, your guide says goodbye in the language you're learning, with the words on screen.
entries.tryIt: Finish a guided episode

entries.title: A new voice for Mia and Leo
entries.description: Newly prepared episodes use ElevenLabs voices, with target-language words said natively.
entries.tryIt: Prepare a new episode and listen to the guide

entries.title: Restore Purchases on a new account
entries.description: Restoring on a new phone or account moves Plus across, keeping the month's used hours.
entries.tryIt: Tap Restore on the Plus screen

entries.title: Saved episodes survive an app update
entries.description: Episodes saved for offline are still there after an update.

entries.title: Pause works while Mia is talking
entries.description: Pause stops the guide mid-moment and play picks up the same moment; a phone call pauses the guide.
entries.tryIt: Pause while the guide is speaking

entries.title: Your place is saved after jumping back
entries.description: Your place is saved straight after jumping backwards, and the wrap-up still plays after skipping the last moment.

entries.title: No false 'Your episode is ready'
entries.description: Only the learner who asked for an episode hears that it's ready.

entries.title: Plus shows the moment you've paid
entries.description: Plus switches on as soon as the App Store confirms, and Restore says clearly when it couldn't reach the App Store.

entries.title: Tell Mia what you're in the mood for
entries.description: Tell Mia what you fancy on Discover and get three shows in your language, each with a line on why it fits.
entries.tryIt: On Discover, tap a mood chip

entries.title: Hands-on, Standard or Light
entries.description: Before listening, pick how often the guide steps in for that episode; your last choice becomes the default.
entries.tryIt: Open a ready episode

entries.title: Mia waits for natural pauses
entries.description: The guide only steps in once someone has finished speaking, and her moments are spread out.

entries.title: Show descriptions, translated
entries.description: Show and episode pages have descriptions, with titles and descriptions in your language too.
entries.tryIt: Open any show page

entries.title: Prepare episodes on your own keys
entries.description: Episodes can be prepared on your own ElevenLabs and Google keys instead of an allowance.
entries.tryIt: You, then Use your own API keys

entries.title: A set-up guide for your own keys
entries.description: Step-by-step help for getting each key, with roughly what an hour costs.
entries.tryIt: You, then Use your own API keys

entries.title: A primer for every episode
entries.description: Every newly prepared episode comes with a short gist, words to listen for and its main themes.
entries.tryIt: Open a newly prepared episode

entries.title: Words to listen for, in the host's voice
entries.description: Each primer word has its meaning, when it comes up and a play button for the host saying it.
entries.tryIt: Open a ready episode and tap a word's play button

entries.title: The primer builds while Mia prepares
entries.description: While an episode prepares, the gist, words and themes appear as soon as they're written.
entries.tryIt: Prepare an episode and stay on its screen

entries.title: The primer before you press play
entries.description: A ready episode opens on its primer, with Skip and play to start straight away.
entries.tryIt: Open a ready episode

entries.title: An episode map
entries.description: The primer shows the episode's sections and where each theme comes up; tap one to start from there.
entries.tryIt: Open a ready episode and tap a theme

entries.title: The yearly plan, made clear
entries.description: The Plus screen marks the yearly plan as best value and says what it works out at each month.
entries.tryIt: Open the Plus screen

entries.title: Share a line as a picture
entries.description: Sharing a line now sends a picture card with the line, its meaning, the show and your flag.
entries.tryIt: Finish an episode and share a line

entries.title: Support Polycast
entries.description: Leave a one-off tip from You or the own-keys screen. It unlocks nothing.
entries.tryIt: You, then Leave a tip

entries.title: The guide's name matches the voice
entries.description: An episode recorded with Mia says Mia everywhere, even after switching to Leo.

entries.title: Pick up where you left off
entries.description: Reopen the app and your last episode waits in the mini-player, paused where you left it.
entries.tryIt: Close the app mid-episode and open it again

entries.title: Faster loading
entries.description: Shows open much faster, and Discover and show pages appear at once from last time.
entries.tryIt: Open a show you've opened before

entries.title: Tabs everywhere, with a mini-player
entries.description: The tabs stay on every screen with a mini-player above them; closing the player keeps the episode playing.
entries.tryIt: Swipe the player down while listening

entries.title: Skip ad
entries.description: During an advert a Skip ad pill sits above the scrubber.
entries.tryIt: Play an episode with adverts

entries.title: A More menu in the player
entries.description: 'Listen to the intro again' moved into the player's More (…) menu.
entries.tryIt: Tap … at the top right of the player

entries.title: One search bar, with an AI button
entries.description: Discover has one bar: search podcasts with the keyboard's search key, or tap the sparkle to ask Mia.
entries.tryIt: Type in the bar on Discover

entries.title: Top charts: plain numbers and genres
entries.description: Top charts show 1, 2, 3 beside each show, with a small genre tag.
entries.tryIt: Discover, then Top charts

entries.title: Listen later
entries.description: Keep any episode for later from its page, or with Later on a show's episode list.
entries.tryIt: Open an episode and tap Listen later

entries.title: A Library built for keeping up
entries.description: The Library opens with Recently listened shows, then Carry on listening, New episodes, Listen later and Downloads.
entries.tryIt: Open the Library tab

entries.title: Follow a show
entries.description: Follow any show from its page; its new episodes show in your Library.
entries.tryIt: Open a show and tap Follow

entries.title: Mia matches the show's volume
entries.description: On newly prepared episodes, the guide plays at a level matched to the show, so she never booms over a quiet one.
entries.tryIt: Prepare a quietly recorded show and listen

entries.title: A cost estimate on your own keys
entries.description: On your own keys, episodes show roughly what preparing will cost; tap it for the split by provider.
entries.tryIt: With your own keys added, open an episode that isn't ready

entries.title: Saving a word never shows a false error
entries.description: Tapping save twice no longer shows an error, and a word only shows as saved once it really is.
entries.tryIt: Tap a word in the subtitles and save it twice quickly

entries.title: Line by line
entries.description: The player can pause after each subtitle line; tap play for the next.
entries.tryIt: In the player, tap … then Line by line

entries.title: What's new
entries.description: This page: what each overnight build changed, and where to try it.
entries.tryIt: You, then What's new

entries.title: Share your lesson recap
entries.description: The wrap-up offers a story-sized recap card (words you picked up, a 'Did you know?' line, minutes, quiz score and podcasts completed) or a 'Word of the episode' card.
entries.tryIt: Finish any episode and tap Share

entries.title: Tell us when a line looks wrong
entries.description: If a subtitle or its translation looks off, flag it from the player and we'll fix it before the next person hears it. Only the line is sent, nothing about you.
entries.tryIt: Press and hold a subtitle line in the player, or open More while a line is showing

entries.title: Hop back after the episode map
entries.description: Jump to a place on the episode map and a small 'Back to where you were' button shows for 15 seconds, so peeking never loses your place.
entries.tryIt: Open an episode you've started, tap a theme on its map, then tap 'Back to where you were'

entries.title: Searching no longer uses up translations
entries.description: Search translates result titles once you stop typing (or press Search), so the show you open next still gets its English lines.
entries.tryIt: Search for a show, refine it a few times, then open one

entries.title: Fairer own-key estimates
entries.description: On your own keys, the cost estimate now leaves out transcription when the show publishes its own transcript or Polycast already has one, and gives a price per hour when the feed doesn't say how long an episode is.
entries.tryIt: With your own keys on, open an episode that isn't ready yet and tap the estimate

entries.title: New episodes from every show you follow
entries.description: The Library now checks all the shows you follow in one go, not just the first 12, and no longer leaves you with 'Give it a moment' when you open a show straight after.
entries.tryIt: Library, then New episodes

entries.title: Line by line stops cleanly
entries.description: Line by line now pauses exactly at the end of each line, even when sped up, so you no longer hear a clipped first syllable of the next one.
entries.tryIt: In the player, More, then Line by line

entries.title: New episodes download on their own
entries.description: Turn on 'Download new episodes' for a show you follow and its new episodes download when you open your Library, on Wi-Fi unless you allow mobile data. On Plus, ones that aren't ready yet are prepared from your Plus hours.
entries.tryIt: Follow a show, then turn on 'Download new episodes' under the Follow button

entries.title: Your first saved word blooms
entries.description: The first time you save a word, Polycast's coral, magenta and violet stems open out under the button, with a line naming the language. It only happens once.
entries.tryIt: While listening, tap a word and save it (if it's your first)

entries.title: The recap counts the episode you just finished
entries.description: The podcasts completed chip on the lesson recap now includes the episode you have just finished, so your first recap shows it too.
entries.tryIt: Finish an episode and look at the recap card

entries.title: Episodes you delete stay deleted
entries.description: Once you remove a downloaded episode, or once one has downloaded on its own, auto-download leaves it alone, so freeing up space sticks.
entries.tryIt: Remove an auto-downloaded episode, then open your Library again

entries.title: An All Saints’ weekend pick on Discover
entries.description: From 28 October to 2 November, Discover adds a mood pick for the holiday weekend in your language, with a short note on how it’s celebrated.
entries.tryIt: Open Discover between 28 October and 2 November and tap the first mood

entries.title: Mia signs your recap card
entries.description: The lesson recap you share now carries a short line from your guide, like Mia: you caught “fika” like a local, with a small Mia or Leo mark.
entries.tryIt: Finish an episode and look at the recap card before you share it

entries.title: Hey Siri, carry on listening
entries.description: Say “Carry on listening in Polycast” to pick up your last lesson, or “Play the newest episode in Polycast” for a show you follow. They also work from Spotlight and the Action button.
entries.tryIt: Ask Siri, or search Polycast in Spotlight

entries.title: New-episode nudges from your guide
entries.description: When a show you finished has a new episode, Mia or Leo tells you, and only ever points you to something you can play right away.
entries.tryIt: Finish an episode, then wait for the show's next one

entries.title: Siri knows the shows you follow
entries.description: “Play the newest episode” now works for shows you follow after installing Polycast, and the shortcuts no longer stop the app building for older iPhones.
entries.tryIt: Follow a new show, then ask Siri to play its newest episode in Polycast

entries.title: You already know some words
entries.description: Right after picking a language, Polycast shows a few words from one of the first shows you could hear that you already know, like Italian “importante”, and the host says each one.
entries.tryIt: Pick a language when you first set up Polycast, then tap a word

entries.title: Fits the iPhone Duo's outer screen
entries.description: On a short, wide screen like the iPhone Duo's outer display, the player makes room for your guide instead of crowding the title and controls.
entries.tryIt: Open any episode on the iPhone Duo's outer screen

entries.title: Plus starts with what's yours
entries.description: The Plus screen now opens with your own progress, like the words you've saved and the episodes you've finished with your guide.
entries.tryIt: Open Plus from the You tab

entries.title: Fresh voices on Discover
entries.description: A new shelf of young, current shows from Spain, Argentina, France and Brazil sits next to the charts in Spanish, French and Portuguese.
entries.tryIt: Open Discover in Spanish, French or Portuguese and scroll past Top charts

entries.title: Video podcasts play as audio
entries.description: When a show publishes episodes as video but also offers an audio version, Polycast now streams and downloads the audio, and video-only episodes wait for Wi-Fi before downloading on their own.
entries.tryIt: Follow a video-first show and turn on Download new episodes

entries.title: VoiceOver speaks each line in its own language
entries.description: With VoiceOver on, subtitles, the primer's words and your saved words are read in the language they're in, and meanings and translations in English.
entries.tryIt: Turn on VoiceOver and swipe through the subtitles while you listen

entries.title: A stamp for the All Saints' weekend
entries.description: Finish an episode with your guide between 28 October and 2 November and you'll keep a small stamp in You, named in your language.
entries.tryIt: From 28 October, finish a guided episode, then look in You

entries.title: Night owl: Mia says goodnight
entries.description: Finish a guided episode after 11 pm and Mia (or Leo) signs off with a goodnight in your language, like Sov gott or Sogni d’oro.
entries.tryIt: Finish a guided episode late in the evening

entries.title: Plus fits the iPhone Duo
entries.description: On a wide screen the Plus page keeps to a readable column with sensibly sized buttons, the folded screen gets a compact footer, and Not now stays put while you scroll.
entries.tryIt: Open Plus from You on an iPhone Duo, folded and open

entries.title: Two panes on the open iPhone Duo
entries.description: With the Duo open, the player shows subtitles on one side and your guide's notes so far, the words to listen for and the words you've saved on the other. Folded, nothing changes.
entries.tryIt: Play a guided episode with your iPhone Duo open

entries.title: A gentle hello on day two
entries.description: If you've signed up but haven't started an episode with your guide a day later, they'll send one notification naming a good first episode and how long it is. Just once.
entries.tryIt: Allow notifications, then wait a day before your first guided listen

entries.title: Your first episode starts with the talking
entries.description: On your very first guided episode, after your guide's welcome, playback starts just before the host's first words, not at theme music or an advert. Play from the very start is there if you want it.
entries.tryIt: Start your first guided episode

entries.title: Older video episodes show once
entries.description: A few video shows listed some older episodes twice. They now show once, with your progress and saved words from both kept together.
entries.tryIt: Open a video show you follow and look through its older episodes

entries.title: Allhelgona when Sweden keeps it
entries.description: If you're learning Swedish, the All Saints' pick on Discover and the Allhelgona stamp now last until Alla helgons dag, the Saturday Sweden keeps it, in years when that's after 2 November.
entries.tryIt: Learning Swedish: look for the All Saints' pick on Discover

entries.title: Stamps land with a soft press
entries.description: The first time you earn a seasonal stamp, it's pressed onto the wrap-up in Polycast's colours with a gentle tap, then kept in You. It's still if Reduce Motion is on.
entries.tryIt: Finish a guided episode between 28 Oct and 2 Nov

entries.title: Ask Mia, not a sparkle
entries.description: The button in Discover’s search bar now shows your guide’s mark and says “Ask Mia” (or Leo), and Discover has its own compass icon.
entries.tryIt: Type a mood in Discover’s search bar and tap Ask Mia

entries.title: Guess the language while Mia prepares
entries.description: While an episode is being prepared, play three seconds of a real host and guess which language it is. Mia tells you what gave it away; nobody keeps score.
entries.tryIt: Prepare an episode and look under the progress card

entries.title: Empty screens with one thing to do
entries.description: Before your first listen, the Words and Library screens offer one button that starts a good first listen in your language, straight in with your guide.
entries.tryIt: Open Words or Library before you’ve listened to anything

entries.title: Host clips play in full on a slow connection
entries.description: When you tap to hear the host say a word, or play the guessing game's clip, it now plays to the end even if the audio takes a moment to load.
entries.tryIt: Tap a word's play button in Review or on an episode's word list
